title: (authz) Gate GET /diag/rangetest: interval body mutates state unauthenticated
description: AUDIT (epic 6mij decomposition): lichen_rangetest_get_handler (lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_rangetest.c:765-828) has NO dispatch auth, yet it (a) MUTATES s_interval_ms from the request body (coap_rangetest.c:798-801, spec/12-apps.md 18.7.3 continuous range test) and (b) registers an RFC 7641 observer slot (coap_rangetest.c:815-823). Any unauthenticated mesh peer can reconfigure the node's continuous-test interval and consume observer slots -> state corruption + airtime/energy drain. GET-with-side-effects must be gated like a mutation. FIX: same house pattern (w063) as POST fix: unprotect already happens at coap_rangetest.c:778; add '(!oscore.is_protected && !lichen_coap_is_local_admin(addr, addr_len)) -> 4.01 via coap_oscore_respond_resource' BEFORE the interval mutation (798) and observe registration (815). Note spec/12-apps.md:1694 lists /diag/rangetest GET+POST in the resource summary; gating applies to the state-changing GET. ACCEPTANCE: (1) unprotected non-admin GET with interval_ms body returns 4.01 and s_interval_ms unchanged (assert via subsequent GET as admin); (2) no observer slot consumed on 4.01 (observe_count==1 path unreachable pre-auth); (3) admin or OSCORE-protected GET behaves as before; (4) extend lichen/tests/coap_rangetest with the gate matrix.
